facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2011-0096 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 22 June 2011 following 1 recorded event in the archive, including CAPA-2005-003. The change request record covers 1 clause across 2 controlled documents. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
